definition: Use the existing Kripke Frame and AFP MProp, Box and Dia: G is an arbitrary world predicate, □G at w means ∀v, Rwv → Gv, and ◇G means ∃v, Rwv ∧ Gv. NecessaryIf is □(G → □G), not G(w) → □G(w). Euclidean means Rwv and Rwz imply Rvz. Task-specific proposition wrappers retain the positive/negative statement identities for exact binding; they introduce no new modal operator or God vocabulary. Coverage is □G ∨ □¬G. Controls lists the fixed Bool models in the Lean type. G is a mathematical parameter; an interpretation as God-existence and metaphysical adequacy of accessibility are additional unproved commitments.
note: Mathematical experiment for #437, without source attribution. A metaphysical application requires independent defense of the proposition, frame profile, boxed conditional and whichever possibility premise is used. Scalar G is not Scott NecessaryExistence, a property of individuals and their essences.
